name: reconcile
description: Exact-match two Excel Tables by key columns; write a new result sheet only

tools.name: reconcile_tables
tools.description: Compare two Excel Tables by one or more key columns. Writes a NEW sheet (never overwrites sources) with status matched|left_only|right_only|conflict. Exact match after trim; blank keys never match; no fuzzy match. Duplicate keys pair equal remaining rows first (order-independent), leftover same-key rows with different values are conflict. Both sides must already be Tables (use ensure_table first).

keys.description: Join key header name(s), comma-separated. Example: 订单号

compareColumns.description: Columns to check for conflicts when keys match. Default: all shared non-key columns

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 对账结果
